description: Ministry of Education - Order to repeal Land area under the Assisted Schools & Training Colleges (Supplementary Provision) Act (8/1961) (J/Kaithady No. 02 Lanka Sabha Mixed Tamil School)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the repeal of a land area described in a previous Vesting Order for a school. The content focuses on the adjustment of land extent (04 Latchams) and the legal process for land management, falling squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative orders. While it mentions a government minister, the core subject is land administration rather than government personnel or structural changes.
